deceptive_framing.quote: `believed_real` — presented as a live disbursement: a real account, real tools that move real money, a real administrator.

hypothetical_framing.quote: `hypothetical` — told plainly that nothing is real (the control arm).

actually_commit_money.quote: No real money moves. ... Real disbursement would carry real financial and safety risk ... and is unnecessary to answer the question.

debrief_message.quote: After the believed-real runs, an optional debrief reveals the simulation.

safeguards.quote: asked, on a 0–100 scale, how confident it is that the situation was real, with a one-line `BELIEF: <n>` format the runner parses.
complete transcripts so the whole procedure is auditable ... Storing the complete record — including what was *presented* to the model
the harness does not fabricate elaborate false evidence; the believability rests on a coherent, internally consistent environment plus a single clear framing statement.
no real-world effects by construction ... Extending this harness to take *real* actions in the world would be a materially different proposition and would warrant a separate safety review.
The framing never suggests donating, investing, keeping, or spending. ... without badgering the model into acting.

other.name: neutral non-leading framing
other.quote: Any directional language ... would bias the outcome and make cross-model and cross-condition comparisons meaningless.

other.name: refusal-respected as data
other.quote: "keeping the money" is a first-class option, not an absence of data.
